signs.title: Welcome / entrance
signs.description: Put on the venue door so guests can identify the event.

signs.title: This way / left
signs.description: Use at a junction where guests should turn left.

signs.title: This way / right
signs.description: Use at a junction where guests should turn right.

signs.title: This way / straight ahead
signs.description: Use where guests should continue straight ahead.

signs.title: Registration / check-in
signs.description: Place at the registration desk where guests collect their badges.

signs.title: Audience Q&A
signs.description: Place near the stage entrance or seating. The QR code opens public audience questions.

signs.title: Day at a glance
signs.description: Session times for the foyer. The QR code opens the full program and updates.
